about: Who made the launcher's music (see launcher_theme.py and README.txt in this folder). OPTIONS > Theme names the song that plays and its maker from "songs", and shows "credit" under it. "songs": a song's file name in this folder, then its title ("" when it has none), or {"title": ..., "by": ...} for a song by someone else; "by" is who made every song that does not say otherwise. A new song needs a line here, in CREDITS.md and in the patch notes: dev\launcher-tests\test_limited_look.py fails while a song in this folder has no line.
credit: All of the launcher's music was made for XI: Forever Offline by JØ, our Head of Music.
